blocks.text: NEW YORK — Authorities are investigating why a small plane carrying six members of a Florida family crashed off the Mississippi coast on Tuesday. They were returning home from a fishing trip, relatives say. The plane’s pilot was Brent Stokes, the 50-year-old president of a marine contracting company based in Fort Myers, according to Jackson
